statement: A Tribute Summon can be a Set: where a card says "Tribute Summon" without "face-up", a monster Set by Tributing counts. Words that need the Summoned monster to be something a face-down monster doesn't show ("If you Tribute Summon a LIGHT monster") aren't met by a Set one.

sources.says: When Tribute Summoning, a monster can be Set face-down in Defense Position as well as Summoned face-up; while Zombie World stops a non-Zombie monster's Tribute Summon, it can't be Tribute Set either.
The extra Tribute Summon that Mithra the Thunder Vassal's effect gives can be made as a face-down Set.
Advance Zone counts the monsters Tributed to Set a monster, and can be activated in a turn whose only Tribute Summons were Sets.
Simorgh, Lord of the Storm Tribute Summoned face-down and flipped face-up later has the effect of one that was Tribute Summoned.

scripts: Soul Exchange's, Escalation of the Monarchs's and Clown Crew Biancaviso's scripts allow a Tribute Set, and the scripts of cards that say "face-up" don't. For the same words, Clown Crew New Face's script includes it and Clown Crew Meteor's doesn't.
